groups.title: Hydraulic bending brakes · value line
groups.lead: Small hydraulic brakes for plate to 3/16″, with a four-way V-block or two cylinders — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: For short parts in plate, the NovoTech value-line HBV24 and HBV48 hydraulic bending brakes bend 5/32″ over 24″ and 48″ with a four-way V-block, and the two-cylinder HBV-1250 and HBV-2540 take 3/16″ over 49″ and 1/8″ over 100″.
